title: 752. Contain Virus

examples.explanation: Seal left with 5 walls, let right spread, seal right with 5.
Four walls close the single ring.
Left ring sealed first, then the right mass.

hints: Each day, flood-fill every connected block of 1s, collecting both its cells and the set of neighboring 0s plus the wall count.
Seal the block with the biggest threatened set, add its wall count to the answer, freeze its cells, and infect the threatened cells of all other blocks.
Repeat until no block touches a healthy cell; frozen cells behave as permanent barriers.
